blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Risa Hontiveros urged the Senate on Wednesday to continue tackling the anti-political dynasty bill, which she had already sponsored before the change in leadership in May. This comes despite the panel being chaired by Sen. Jinggoy Estrada, who is currently detained and under preventive suspension over a plunder case before the Sandiganbayan. “The committee is now under new leadership. I fully respect that. I also understand that I no longer have authority to continue sponsoring the measure without the consent of the present committee leadership… But I hope the work does not stop simply because the chairpersonship […]...
